app.analyzeComplete: National analysis complete for {date}. Refresh the report view if needed.
app.noReportYet: No assessment is available yet. Generate one on the server and refresh this page.
app.northReportMissingHint: No north report is available for today. Generate one with: npm run assess-signals -- --date YYYY-MM-DD --scope north (the news-only pipeline does not produce a north artifact).
app.nationalReportMissingHint: This report could not be loaded — it may no longer be available, or your selection may be out of date. Try picking a different report from the menu, or refresh the page.

settings.accountAnonymous: Sign-in is not required for this deployment. If your admin enables auth, you can sign in from the app entry screen.
settings.analystBody: Open the separate analyst dashboard for model calibration — scores, drift, pipeline status, and validation review.
settings.analystNotGranted: This signed-in account does not have analyst access.
settings.generalBody: Srulik's lab — homefront daily assessment. The home view is your daily assessment; use Data sources below the header to browse input feeds.
settings.localOnly: These choices are saved in this browser. Server-side preferences and email delivery will connect when mailing is enabled on the backend.
settings.mailingDestinationHelp: If empty, your sign-in email is used when you are logged in. Enter another address to override.
settings.mailingIntro: Set the address for digest emails and choose which products to include. When you are signed in and the server is configured (Resend), preferences sync to the server and you can send a digest on demand. Daily sends use a server cron job — see deployment docs.
settings.mailingLanguageHelp: Choose the language for daily and on-demand digest emails.
settings.mailingNeedSignIn: Sign in to sync mailing preferences and send digests.
settings.mailingNotConfigured: Email delivery is not configured on the server.
settings.mailingProductsSub: Check the items to include in each digest email.
settings.mailingSavedDestination: Current digest destination: {email}. Enter a different address above to replace it.
settings.privacyBody: Submissions and evidence you send are processed according to your organization’s policies. See product documentation for details.
